description_en: Queries information about the AD domain of an instance. The information includes whether the instance is added to the AD domain, the name of the AD domain, and the account
description_zh: 该接口用于查询当前实例域相关信息, 包括是否已经加入域、域名称、所使用账号等
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-ad-info --db-instance-id rm-bp1k8s41l2o520000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeADInfo

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

ADDNS.description_en: The DNS information about the AD domain

ADServerIpAddress.description_en: The service IP address of the AD domain

ADStatus.description_en:
The status of the AD domain. Valid values:

-1: The instance is being added to the AD domain.
0: The instance fails to be added to the AD domain.
1: The instance is added to the AD domain
ADStatus.description_zh:
AD域的状态。返回值：
-1：正在加入AD域。
0：加入AD域失败。
1：加入AD域成功

UserName.description_en: The username of the AD domain
